selected.item: Seedance 2.5 Flash: ByteDance's Volcano Engine announced a faster, lower-cost tier of the Seedance 2.5 video-generation model on November 12, 2026. Generation is twice as fast as Seedance 2.5, and the price is about 34% lower for 720p text-to-video and image-to-video, about 0.99 yuan per second. Clips of up to 30 seconds at 480p or 720p; up to 10 images, 5 videos and 5 audio clips per request; video editing is supported. Positioned for high-volume work such as testing ad creative and producing regular footage, while Seedance 2.5 stays the choice for the highest quality, 1080p and 4K, and Draft mode. Rolling out on Jimeng (Dreamina), LibTV, Updream, Creao AI and TapNow; the API is scheduled to open on Volcano Ark on November 15. All performance and price figures are ByteDance's own, not independent verification.
selected.note: The official announcement was made by ByteDance's Volcano Engine (announcement published November 12, 2026, 14:11 UTC+08, via its WeChat account); no direct web announcement URL was locatable, so the announcement date and facts are recorded from the announcement as reported by multiple outlets (PANews, IT Home via WaveSpeedAI, Pandaily). The linked primary page is BytePlus's official Seedance 2.5 Flash model page (ByteDance's international platform); its text fetch returned only the title, so the specs above are taken from the reported announcement, not from that page's body text. Not covered in earlier issues of this series.
